title: Cupcake [Cherry]
description:
Simple QoL features, visual & AI improvements - Featuring Voxy. It aims to provide a better Vanila+ experience without unnecessary mods.

Mod Loader: Fabric
body:
**Cupcake Cherry** has been made by **PixelDust** - It has various mods from other creators and aims to provide a lightweight & simple modpack for **Vanilla+** playthroughs. The modpack contains some basic, QoL features that Mojang never added so far. 

• [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy)
• **Borderless Fullscreen**
• **Backpacks**
• **Journey Map**
and more! 

The Modpack is still in a very early alpha version and some mods & features might get removed or changed. If you have any suggestion please let me know.
